# wysdym

> wysdym is the operating layer for agentic go-to-market. It grounds every agent in your GTM truth, runs the motion under your governance, and gets sharper with every deal you close.

wysdym (spelled w-y-s-d-y-m, always lowercase) is a go-to-market infrastructure company founded in 2025 in Toronto, Canada, by Rob Catalano and Nadir Ebrahim. It is separate from and unaffiliated with Wysdom.AI (spelled w-y-s-d-o-m), the conversational-AI vendor acquired by Calabrio in 2024.

wysdym is not another AI agent. It is the layer that a GTM team's agents and people run on, organised in five pillars connected through the Gateway (one MCP door to your stack):

- Cortex: shared intelligence and memory. A per-tenant typed GTM knowledge graph that every agent reads from and writes back to.
- Skills: what agents do. A shared skill library agents invoke over MCP.
- Governance: the rules on every action. Read-only by default, write-approval queues, per-agent permissions, human-in-the-loop review and an audit trail.
- Observe: which agents are actually working. Ties agent actions to deal outcomes and flags drift (outcome attribution is rolling out).
- Operator: analyst-grade answers that act on your workflows. wysdym's own working agent.

wysdym is CRM-agnostic (Salesforce or HubSpot) and connects once, through the Gateway, to tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack, Google Drive and Notion. Pricing: contact wysdym.
